items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: And the captain on that boat, he's a very peculiar fella. He wants you to... He set the 10-4 for you.

ctx.x: Just ordinary stocks. Just ordinary stocks.

And the captain on that boat, he's a very peculiar fella. He wants you to... He set the 10-4 for you. He'd get out there with his watch. He'd time you. He wanted... It's got to be just right. And you got 12 numbers to play a night, and you got to get them all in. That was one of the... That's Captain Roy's Streckfus. Roy's Streckfus. He had to take orders from his brother, Joe Streckfus. That's the man one. He stays in St. Louis. He don't come down there.
I remember Baby Dobbs, the drummer, told me about.
